final: WITH counts AS (SELECT store_id AS home_store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_count FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT c.home_store_id, c.customer_count, CAST(c.customer_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS store_share FROM counts c JOIN total t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(store_share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.home_store_id, s.customer_count, s.store_share, s.store_share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM shares s JOIN avg_share a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.store_share > a.avg_share ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
